summary: Inventory rules: use a reachable IP or FQDN (no `-` or `_` in the FQDN, never `localhost`); include `[database]` only for an installer-managed database; the initial user `admin` can't be renamed; `pg_password` only supports `!`, `#`, `0` and `@` as special characters; set `registry_username`/`registry_password` (needed only for non-bundle installers).
questions: Which special characters can I use in pg_password?
Can I change the default admin username in AAP?
Can I use localhost in the AAP inventory?
When do I need registry_username and registry_password?
Should I include the [database] group with an external database?
